visual_action: A montage of Melania Trump in various settings: adjusting place settings at a long formal dining table, speaking outdoors while wearing a hat and sunglasses, walking outside Lejeune High School, waving to a crowd in an auditorium, smiling while talking to people including a young girl, and playing a ring toss game with a person in an Easter Bunny costume on a lawn. The montage also includes several short clips of Usha Vance smiling.
